author: National Geographic
description:
All around the globe, extraordinary people are pushing the limits of what humans are capable of. David Blaine travels to all corners of planet Earth to meet and learn about these people in this David Blaine: Do Not Attempt MEGA Episode. Featuring three, complete full episodes: 

Southeast Asia - 0:00
David ventures to Southeast Asia to meet people performing with venomous creatures, pushing the relationship between fear and magic to the edge.

Brazil - 44:54
In Brazil, David meets daredevils, artists, explorers and athletes who unite to help execute an audacious leap of faith that he’s long dreamt of.

Arctic Circle - 1:28:41
In the Arctic Circle, David Blaine explores humanity’s ability to endure extreme temperatures in search of new ways to astound.
